headlines.headline: COURT-ORDERED FIFTH-YEAR TRANSFER PORTAL WINDOW OPENS TODAY, RUNS THROUGH AUG. 10, AS NCAA CALLS SITUATION 'CHAOS'
headlines.detail: The special transfer portal window for players who gained a bonus fifth season of eligibility under Judge Charlotte Sweeney's Friday injunction opened today and runs through Aug. 10; NCAA president Charlie Baker publicly criticized the ruling and renewed his call for Congress to grant the NCAA federal protections, while most programs - already having spent their scholarship budgets and locked rotations - brace for late-summer roster scrambling.

headlines.headline: PATRICK EWING JOINS WIZARDS' COACHING STAFF, TASKED WITH DEVELOPING A FRONTCOURT OF ANTHONY DAVIS, ALEX SARR AND DEANDRE AYTON
headlines.detail: Washington hired Hall of Fame center Patrick Ewing as an assistant coach, adding a big-man specialist to a staff that must now integrate Anthony Davis - who becomes extension-eligible Aug. 6 - alongside young center Alex Sarr and veteran Deandre Ayton in a suddenly crowded frontcourt rotation.

headlines.headline: NFL TRAINING CAMP INJURY TOLL MOUNTS: BEARS SAFETY COBY BRYANT OUT 8-10 WEEKS, FOUR OTHER PLAYERS ALREADY DONE FOR 2026
headlines.detail: Chicago safety Coby Bryant is expected to miss 8-10 weeks with a knee injury suffered in Monday's practice, joining a growing season-ending list that already includes 49ers receiver Ricky Pearsall, Panthers rookie Chris Brazzell, Panthers pass rusher Nic Scourton and Saints defensive tackle Bryan Bresee as all 32 teams enter the second week of camp.

headlines.headline: UNC PLACES FOOTBALL GM MICHAEL LOMBARDI ON LEAVE; HE RETAINS ATTORNEY TOM MARS AMID INTERNAL INVESTIGATION
headlines.detail: North Carolina placed general manager Michael Lombardi on administrative leave this week amid an internal investigation into the football program, and Lombardi has since retained prominent college-sports attorney Tom Mars as the case unfolds in the run-up to the season opener later this month.
